# IMPERIA COLD WAR — SOV01 diplomatic transaction repair.
# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: SOV 1970 on actions — event hooks.
## COLDWAR | Cold War mod (MD Imperia) - Soviet Union 1970
## Generated by the COLDWAR Soviet generator (Claude outputs/COLDWAR_SOV_generator) from the approved design
## (project doc claude/mdcw_sov_1970_focus_tree_design.md). Edit the generator, not this file.
## Search for 'COLDWAR' to find every Cold War addition.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			# on_startup has no country scope: enter SOV explicitly (only the 1970 history block initialises it)
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_initialized } }
				SOV = { COLDWAR_SOV_setup_politburo = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	on_monthly_SOV = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = SOV has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_initialized }
				COLDWAR_SOV_monthly_cohesion = yes
				# COLDWAR SOV v4: COLDWAR_SOV_monthly_bop_drift replaced by COLDWAR_PB_balance_drift (COLDWAR_SOVR_monthly)
				COLDWAR_SOV01_B_retry_pending = yes
				COLDWAR_SOV_monthly_comecon_refund = yes
				COLDWAR_SOV_pb_monthly = yes           # the Politburo dossier and Socialist Emulation (cw_pbgui.py, cw_emulation.py)
			}
		}
	}
}
